newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON RALLY TO BEAT QUEENSLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON RALLY TO BEAT QUEENSLAND.

text.p: Wellington staged an outstanding revival to move into fifth place in the Super 12 table with a 47-29 win over struggling Queensland on Saturday.
The New Zealanders scored six tries to two at Ballymore to earn an extra bonus point after falling 17-0 behind early in the game.
The defeat added to the gloom for Queensland, the fallen giants of southern hemisphere rugby who have won only once in seven outings this season after reaching the semifinals last year.
They appeared poised for a morale-boosting win when full-back Tim Horan and winger Willie Carne scored early tries but Wellington fought back to lead 25-17 at halftime.
Their victory lifts them to fifth with 17 points from six games.

Wellington scrum-half Jon Preston inflicted the final embarrassment late on when he followed up his own penalty attempt to gather the ball and dive over for a try after the ball rebounded from a post.
Winger Alex Telea scored two tries to add to scores by fly-half Stephen Bachop, centre Jason O'Halloran and winger Tana Umaga.
Preston added four conversions and three penalties for a personal tally of 22 points.
Queensland second rower and Australia test captain John Eales was equally accurate with the boot, converting both his side's tries and kicking five penalties.
Queensland made a string of unforced errors as the visitors opted to run the ball wide at every opportunity with great effect.

Queensland - Tim Horan (captain), Damian Smith, Ben Tune, Jason Little, Willie Carne, Tyron Mandrusiak, Brett Johnstone, Mark Connors, David Wilson, Toutai Kefu, Matt Cockbain, John Eales, Glen Panoho, Brendan Cannon, Dan Crowley.

Wellington - Christian Cullen, Tana Umaga, Jason O'Halloran, Alama Ieremia, Alex Telea, Steven Bachop, Jon Preston, Karl Williams, Martin Leslie, Chresten Davis, Mark Cooksley, Dion Waller, Phil Coffin, Norm Hewitt, Mark Allen (captain).
